simple.meaning: שׂוּם (sûwm) appears 586 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, beginning at Genesis 2:8. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׂוּם (H7760) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שׂוּם through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: שׂוּם (sûwm) / H7760 is tracked through Genesis 2:8, Genesis 4:15, Genesis 6:16, Genesis 9:23. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
